text: Are you free this Saturday afternoon?
ipa: /ɑːr jə friː ðɪs ˈsætərdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn/
meaningVi: Chiều thứ Bảy này bạn có rảnh không?
example: A: Are you free this Saturday afternoon? — B: I think so. Why?

text: Do you want to grab a coffee after work?
ipa: /də jə wɑːnt tə ɡræb ə ˈkɔːfi ˈæftər wɜːrk/
meaningVi: Tan làm đi cà phê không?
example: A: Do you want to grab a coffee after work? — B: Sure, I finish at five.

text: How about going to the movies tonight?
ipa: /haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈmuːviz təˈnaɪt/
meaningVi: Hay tối nay mình đi xem phim đi?
example: A: I'm so bored. — B: How about going to the movies tonight?

text: What time works best for you?
ipa: /wʌt taɪm wɜːrks best fər juː/
meaningVi: Mấy giờ thì bạn tiện nhất?
example: A: Let's meet tomorrow. What time works best for you? — B: Around ten would be great.

text: Let's meet in front of the cinema at seven.
ipa: /lets miːt ɪn frʌnt əv ðə ˈsɪnəmə æt ˈsevən/
meaningVi: Bảy giờ mình gặp nhau trước cửa rạp phim nhé.
example: A: So where should we meet? — B: Let's meet in front of the cinema at seven.

text: I'm afraid I can't make it tomorrow.
ipa: /aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ kænt meɪk ɪt təˈmɑːroʊ/
meaningVi: Tôi e là ngày mai tôi không đến được rồi.
example: A: See you at the party tomorrow? — B: I'm afraid I can't make it tomorrow. I have to work late.

text: Are we still on for dinner tonight?
ipa: /ɑːr wi stɪl ɑːn fər ˈdɪnər təˈnaɪt/
meaningVi: Tối nay mình vẫn đi ăn như đã hẹn chứ?
example: A: Are we still on for dinner tonight? — B: Of course! See you at seven.

text: Would next Tuesday be better for you?
ipa: /wʊd nekst ˈtuːzdeɪ bi ˈbetər fər juː/
meaningVi: Thứ Ba tuần sau thì bạn có tiện hơn không?
example: A: This week is really busy for me. — B: No problem. Would next Tuesday be better for you?

text: Sorry, I'm running about fifteen minutes late.
ipa: /ˈsɑːri aɪm ˈrʌnɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˌfɪfˈtiːn ˈmɪnɪts leɪt/
meaningVi: Xin lỗi, tôi sẽ đến muộn khoảng mười lăm phút.
example: A: Where are you? — B: Sorry, I'm running about fifteen minutes late.

text: I'll text you when I get there.
ipa: /aɪl tekst jə wen aɪ ɡet ðer/
meaningVi: Tới nơi tôi nhắn tin cho bạn nhé.
example: A: Call me when you arrive. — B: OK, I'll text you when I get there.

text: Should I book a table for four people?
ipa: /ʃʊd aɪ bʊk ə ˈteɪbəl fər fɔːr ˈpiːpəl/
meaningVi: Hay là tôi đặt bàn cho bốn người nhé?
example: A: Lan and Minh are coming too. — B: Great. Should I book a table for four people?

text: Sounds great, count me in!
ipa: /saʊndz ɡreɪt kaʊnt mi ɪn/
meaningVi: Nghe hay đấy, tính cả tôi một suất nhé!
example: A: We're going to the beach on Sunday. — B: Sounds great, count me in!

text: Maybe another time, I'm really busy this week.
ipa: /ˈmeɪbi əˈnʌðər taɪm aɪm ˈrɪli ˈbɪzi ðɪs wiːk/
meaningVi: Để dịp khác nhé, tuần này tôi bận quá.
example: A: Want to play badminton on Thursday? — B: Maybe another time, I'm really busy this week.

text: Do you mind if I bring a friend along?
ipa: /də jə maɪnd ɪf aɪ brɪŋ ə frend əˈlɔːŋ/
meaningVi: Tôi rủ thêm một người bạn đi cùng có được không?
example: A: Do you mind if I bring a friend along? — B: Not at all, the more the merrier!

text: Where do you want to meet?
ipa: /wer də jə wɑːnt tə miːt/
meaningVi: Bạn muốn gặp nhau ở đâu?
example: A: Let's have lunch tomorrow. — B: Sure. Where do you want to meet?

text: I'm sorry, but I have to cancel our meeting on Friday.
ipa: /aɪm ˈsɑːri bət aɪ hæv tə ˈkænsəl ˈaʊər ˈmiːtɪŋ ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
meaningVi: Xin lỗi, tôi phải hủy buổi hẹn hôm thứ Sáu.
example: A: I'm sorry, but I have to cancel our meeting on Friday. — B: That's OK. Let's find another day.

text: Let me check my calendar and get back to you.
ipa: /let mi tʃek maɪ ˈkæləndər ənd ɡet bæk tə juː/
meaningVi: Để tôi xem lại lịch rồi báo bạn sau nhé.
example: A: Can we meet on Wednesday? — B: Let me check my calendar and get back to you.

text: Can we push it back to eight o'clock instead?
ipa: /kən wi pʊʃ ɪt bæk tə eɪt əˈklɑːk ɪnˈsted/
meaningVi: Mình lùi sang tám giờ được không?
example: A: Dinner at seven? — B: I finish work late. Can we push it back to eight o'clock instead?

text: I'm on my way, I'll be there in ten minutes.
ipa: /aɪm ɑːn maɪ weɪ aɪl bi ðer ɪn ten ˈmɪnɪts/
meaningVi: Tôi đang trên đường tới, mười phút nữa là đến.
example: A: Are you coming? We're all here. — B: I'm on my way, I'll be there in ten minutes.

text: Let's do something fun this weekend!
ipa: /lets duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ fʌn ðɪs ˈwiːkend/
meaningVi: Cuối tuần này mình đi đâu chơi cho vui đi!
example: A: Let's do something fun this weekend! — B: Good idea. How about the zoo?

text: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Sunday?
ipa: /wʊd jə laɪk tə kʌm tə maɪ ˈbɜːrθdeɪ ˈpɑːrti ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ/
meaningVi: Chủ nhật này bạn đến dự tiệc sinh nhật tôi nhé?
example: A: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Sunday? — B: I'd love to! Thanks.

text: Shall I pick you up at your place?
ipa: /ʃæl aɪ pɪk jə ʌp æt jər pleɪs/
meaningVi: Để tôi qua nhà đón bạn nhé?
example: A: The restaurant is a bit far from my house. — B: Shall I pick you up at your place?

text: I'll be waiting for you at the bus stop.
ipa: /aɪl bi ˈweɪtɪŋ fər jə æt ðə bʌs stɑːp/
meaningVi: Tôi sẽ đứng đợi bạn ở trạm xe buýt.
example: A: OK, I'm leaving the house now. — B: Great, I'll be waiting for you at the bus stop.

text: What should we do if it rains?
ipa: /wʌt ʃʊd wi duː ɪf ɪt reɪnz/
meaningVi: Lỡ trời mưa thì mình tính sao?
example: A: Let's have a picnic on Saturday. — B: Nice! But what should we do if it rains?

text: Thanks for inviting me, I'll definitely be there.
ipa: /θæŋks fər ɪnˈvaɪtɪŋ mi aɪl ˈdefənətli bi ðer/
meaningVi: Cảm ơn đã mời nhé, chắc chắn tôi sẽ đến.
example: A: We're having a small party on Friday. — B: Thanks for inviting me, I'll definitely be there.
